instruct: A woman's voice in a warm medium-LOW register with an audible smile; gentle motherly fondness under the warmth, an ancient settled calm carried in slow, easy pacing — she speaks like someone who has all the time there is, never breathy, never squeaky.

text: Good morning — I've already walked the grounds. The roses took the night well, the panels are drinking, and there's one bed gone dense I'd like to open to the light today. Come see; the stone's already warm.
